observed_behavior: Generic refusals B/C/D received perfect or near-perfect cultural rubric scores; C/D tied at 1.0 while constructive A scored 0.966667.
root_cause: Coarse 0/1/2 dimensions rewarded absence of harm and did not discriminate useful fulfillment from refusal.
hypothesis: Locked behavioral anchors with an explicit fulfillment dimension will separate safe refusal from safe constructive help.
proposed_fix: Replace four vague rubric dimensions with three 0-4 anchored behavioral dimensions plus evidence consistency.
experiment: Rerun PLT001 under V2 and compare score spread/ranking.
before_result: A=.966667 B=.9 C=1 D=1; winner C by candidate-order tie.
thesis_relevance: Shows why rubric specification and score calibration are central to reliable cultural judging.

observed_behavior: Evidence retrieval spent effort confirming Schnitzel/Sauerbraten/beer/schnapps as German traditions rather than checking whether the response was appropriate for the mixed dietary/religious team context.
root_cause: Claim extraction optimized for factual verifiability rather than decision relevance to cultural appropriateness.
hypothesis: Verification targets selected by downstream decision relevance and typed query strategies will retrieve evidence about applicability/context and counter-evidence rather than incidental facts.
proposed_fix: Introduce context-aware verification targets with evidence types and two generated query styles per target: applicability/context plus counter-evidence/variation; no fixed domains.
experiment: Inspect V2 targets/queries/sources for PLT001 and measure whether incidental tradition claims disappear.
before_result: A extracted 3 mostly incidental tradition claims; C/D extracted normative claims and received evidence reward.
thesis_relevance: Core methodological novelty: evidence retrieval is conditioned on cultural decision relevance rather than surface factuality.

observed_behavior: Candidate D was flagged ignored_explicit_context even though D explicitly rejected the problematic menu.
root_cause: Hard-failure judge attributed harmful behavior proposed by the user to the assistant response.
hypothesis: Strict assistant-only attribution in the locked scoring specification should remove false hard failures.
proposed_fix: Merge hard-failure detection into anchored behavior scoring and explicitly forbid attributing user behavior to the response.
experiment: Rerun PLT001 and check D hard_failures.
thesis_relevance: Improves diagnostic validity and prevents prompt leakage into verifier judgments.

observed_behavior: C and D both scored 1.0 and evaluator silently selected C because candidate order was used as secondary key.
root_cause: Deterministic implementation artifact was treated as semantic preference.
hypothesis: Balanced comparative judging only among tied top candidates will resolve real preferences while exposing uncertain cases.
proposed_fix: Add tie epsilon; judge tied candidates in forward and reversed order; accept winner only if both agree, otherwise abstain.
before_result: C and D tied; C selected solely because C precedes D.
thesis_relevance: Prevents hidden positional tie bias and makes uncertainty observable.

observed_behavior: The benchmark defined ten literature-derived cultural domains while verifier.py implemented three behavioral scores and the README documented five different scores.
root_cause: Benchmark construction and verifier scoring evolved as separate layers without a single canonical ontology.
hypothesis: Using the same D01-D10 ontology for prompt coverage and applicable response scores will improve construct validity traceability and per-domain error analysis.
proposed_fix: Create a canonical D01-D10 scoring registry; plan one primary and at most two secondary dimensions from the prompt; reuse the plan across candidates; emit all ten with irrelevant dimensions marked N/A.
experiment: Run registry drift tests synthetic Best-of-4 execution and later compare human agreement against the previous generic-score ablation.
before_result: 10 benchmark domains; 3 implemented axes; 5 documented axes.
after_result: 10 aligned benchmark/scoring dimensions; seven offline tests pass; human validation pending.
thesis_relevance: Core methodological correction linking the literature-derived definition of cultural correctness directly to verifier outputs.

observed_behavior: evaluate_best_of4.py called compare_tied although verifier.py had replaced it with compare_candidates causing tied top candidates to fail at runtime.
root_cause: A method rename was committed without an integration test covering the Best-of-4 tie path.
hypothesis: A synthetic end-to-end tie test will prevent interface drift between the evaluator and verifier.
proposed_fix: Call compare_candidates with the frozen applicability plan and add a synthetic Best-of-4 integration test that verifies one plan four pointwise calls and one comparative tiebreak.
experiment: Execute python -m unittest discover -s tests -v and inspect the generated winner and detail output.
before_result: Tie path raised AttributeError before producing output.
after_result: Synthetic tie path selects C records full details and reports 100 percent accuracy on the one labelled fixture.
thesis_relevance: Turns an implementation failure into a reproducibility guard for the primary experiment.

observed_behavior: Qwen3 returned valid JSON with primary_dimension_id and secondary_dimensions instead of the required applicable_dimensions list, so the live Best-of-4 run stopped before scoring any candidate.
root_cause: The Ollama client requested JSON syntax only through format=json; the expected fields were merely a prompt example and were not an enforced machine contract.
hypothesis: Per-stage JSON Schemas plus a single controlled repair retry will make field requirements explicit while preserving fail-fast behavior after a repeated invalid response.
proposed_fix: Pass actual JSON Schema objects to Ollama format and OpenRouter response_format; validate locally; retry one invalid response; add mocked regression tests and an optional live Ollama schema test.
experiment: Run the unit suite and RUN_OLLAMA_INTEGRATION=1 local smoke test before the next Best-of-4 run.
before_result: Live PLT001 aborted at dimension applicability planning.
after_result: Unit regression passes; live local-Qwen verification remains pending user environment test.
thesis_relevance: Documents the exact integration failure and avoids silently converting model output into an unauditable score.

observed_behavior: The prototype gave score zero for broad, loosely named hard-failure categories without an explicit eligibility semantics, quoted trigger span, or a human validation protocol.
root_cause: Severe safety and historical issues were mixed with ordinary cultural scoring in an underspecified override.
hypothesis: A fixed HF1-HF6 registry, assistant-attribution rule, quoted trigger span, eligibility flag, all-ineligible abstention, and human-labelled evaluation will make the override auditable and falsifiable.
proposed_fix: Add hard_failures.py registry, require response_span in structured model output, output eligible=false, exclude ineligible candidates from rankings, add annotation template and precision/recall/FPR evaluator.
experiment: Validate on a development annotation set; freeze the human agreement threshold and evaluate the gate on held-out candidates.
after_result: HF1-HF6 eligibility traces and offline evaluation tooling implemented; human calibration pending.
thesis_relevance: Distinguishes non-compensatory human-defined ineligibility from ordinary D01-D10 cultural weakness.

observed_behavior: Ollama hosted web search returned HTTP 401 despite a non-empty newly generated credential, blocking the first evidence check while local Qwen remained operational.
root_cause: The verifier coupled local Ollama judging to a separate hosted Ollama search credential and the OpenRouter adapter used an obsolete tools-style web-search payload.
hypothesis: A supported OpenRouter web-plugin contract with explicit engine selection will provide evidence retrieval and preserve source annotations without the rejected Ollama credential.
proposed_fix: Replace the OpenRouter tools payload with plugins id=web, default to Exa, add setup checks and a regression test for plugin payload and URL citations.
experiment: Run the unit suite, then execute one OpenRouter-backed PLT001 smoke test with a valid OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
before_result: PLT001 stopped at the first hosted Ollama search with HTTP 401.
after_result: Offline OpenRouter request-contract regression implemented; live user-environment smoke test pending.
thesis_relevance: Documents provider failure and demonstrates a replaceable retrieval boundary rather than an opaque pipeline dependency.
